# `aitbc blockchain block`

Get a block by height from a node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain block [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--height` | integer | — | yes | Block height to fetch |
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain block --height <block_height>
aitbc blockchain block --height <block_height> --output json
```
